newsitem.title: CANADA: Adamas Resources Corp to buy Hercules Gold.
newsitem.headline: Adamas Resources Corp to buy Hercules Gold.

text.p: Adamas Resources Corp on Tuesday signed a letter of intent to buy 100 percent of the Hercules Gold Project in Nevada, a company statement said.

Under the deal, Adamas will hold a 100 percent interest in the project so long as advance annual royalty payments and the BLM/county filing fees on the project's claims are paid each year, the statement said.
Adamas Resources will also be required to complete a minimum annual work program of US$100,000, it said.
Total payment for the project is US$200,000 and a five percent Net Smelter Returns (NSR) production royalty, it said.
Adamas will have the right to acquire the NSR royalty in its entirety for US$4,500,000 or Adamas may buy-down the NSR royalty on the basis of US$1,000,000 per percentage point (1.0 percent), it said.
Exploration work to date indicates a large, near surface economic gold system which justifies aggressive additional delineation drilling, it said.

Using a cut-off grade of 0.019 oz. Au/ST, current proven and probable open pit reserves at the project total 7,312,612 ST at an average grade of 0.023 oz Au/ST and 0.159 oz. Ag/ST (containing 169,746 oz. Au and 1,164,369 oz Ag), it said.

Possible additional reserves, based on extensions to known ore reserves and resources, are estimated at 20 to 50 million tons grading on the order of 0.040 to 0.045 oz Au/ST, representing a total potential resource of approximately 2.0 to 2.5 million ounces of gold and upwards of 18 million ounces of silver, it said.
The reserves are defined by drilling, surface and underground sampling, and are located in several proximal, partially delineated zones, it said.
